CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_route_family_for_product(p_product_id integer, p_as_of_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_date date := coalesce(p_as_of_date,current_date);
  v_product_family bigint;
  v_subgroup_family bigint;
  v_group_family bigint;
begin
  select m.route_family_id
  into v_product_family
  from costing.production_route_family_product_map m
  join costing.production_route_family f on f.id=m.route_family_id
  where m.product_id=p_product_id
    and m.archived_at is null
    and m.status='APPROVED'
    and m.effective_from<=v_date
    and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to>=v_date)
    and f.archived_at is null
    and f.status='APPROVED'
    and f.effective_from<=v_date
    and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  order by m.effective_from desc,m.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_product_family is not null then
    return v_product_family;
  end if;

  select sm.route_family_id
  into v_subgroup_family
  from public.products p
  join costing.production_route_family_product_subgroup_map sm
    on sm.product_subgroup_id=p.sub_group_id
   and sm.archived_at is null
   and sm.status='APPROVED'
   and sm.effective_from<=v_date
   and (sm.effective_to is null or sm.effective_to>=v_date)
  join costing.production_route_family f
    on f.id=sm.route_family_id
   and f.archived_at is null
   and f.status='APPROVED'
   and f.effective_from<=v_date
   and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  where p.id=p_product_id
  order by sm.effective_from desc,sm.id desc
  limit 1;

  if v_subgroup_family is not null then
    return v_subgroup_family;
  end if;

  select gm.route_family_id
  into v_group_family
  from public.products p
  join public.sub_groups sg on sg.id=p.sub_group_id
  join costing.production_route_family_product_group_map gm
    on gm.product_group_id=sg.product_group_id
   and gm.archived_at is null
   and gm.status='APPROVED'
   and gm.effective_from<=v_date
   and (gm.effective_to is null or gm.effective_to>=v_date)
  join costing.production_route_family f
    on f.id=gm.route_family_id
   and f.archived_at is null
   and f.status='APPROVED'
   and f.effective_from<=v_date
   and (f.effective_to is null or f.effective_to>=v_date)
  where p.id=p_product_id
  order by gm.effective_from desc,gm.id desc
  limit 1;

  return v_group_family;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_resolve_sku_mrp_as_of(p_sku_id bigint, p_valuation_date date)
 RETURNS TABLE(sku_id bigint, valuation_date date, resolution_status text, qualifying_policy_count bigint, policy_id bigint, mrp_ik numeric, mrp_ok numeric, ok_pct numeric, calc_mode text, effective_from date, effective_to date, source_type text, source_quality text, approval_reference text, resolution_note text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

with qualifying as (
    select
        p.id as policy_id,
        p.sku_id,
        p.mrp_ik,
        p.mrp_ok,
        p.ok_pct,
        p.calc_mode,
        p.effective_from,
        p.effective_to,
        p.source_type,
        p.source_quality,
        p.approval_reference

    from costing.sku_mrp_policy p

    where p.sku_id = p_sku_id
      and p.status = 'APPROVED'
      and p.effective_from <= p_valuation_date
      and (
           p.effective_to is null
        or p.effective_to >= p_valuation_date
      )
),

qualified_count as (
    select count(*)::bigint as policy_count
    from qualifying
),

single_policy as (
    select q.*
    from qualifying q
    cross join qualified_count c
    where c.policy_count = 1
)

select
    p_sku_id as sku_id,
    p_valuation_date as valuation_date,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 0
            then 'MISSING'

        when c.policy_count = 1
            then 'RESOLVED'

        else 'AMBIGUOUS'
    end as resolution_status,

    c.policy_count as qualifying_policy_count,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.policy_id
        else null::bigint
    end as policy_id,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.mrp_ik
        else null::numeric
    end as mrp_ik,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.mrp_ok
        else null::numeric
    end as mrp_ok,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.ok_pct
        else null::numeric
    end as ok_pct,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.calc_mode
        else null::text
    end as calc_mode,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.effective_from
        else null::date
    end as effective_from,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.effective_to
        else null::date
    end as effective_to,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.source_type
        else null::text
    end as source_type,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.source_quality
        else null::text
    end as source_quality,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 1
            then sp.approval_reference
        else null::text
    end as approval_reference,

    case
        when c.policy_count = 0 then
            format(
                'No approved SKU MRP policy is effective on valuation date %s.',
                p_valuation_date
            )

        when c.policy_count = 1 then
            format(
                'Approved SKU MRP policy %s resolved for valuation date %s.',
                sp.policy_id,
                p_valuation_date
            )

        else
            format(
                '%s approved SKU MRP policies overlap on valuation date %s; resolution is blocked.',
                c.policy_count,
                p_valuation_date
            )
    end as resolution_note

from qualified_count c
left join single_policy sp
  on true;

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_wp04_readiness_bump_source_epoch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_relation text := format('%I.%I',TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,TG_TABLE_NAME);
BEGIN
  UPDATE costing.readiness_portfolio_source_epoch
     SET epoch=epoch+1,
         touched_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE source_relation=v_relation;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unregistered readiness source relation %',v_relation;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION costing.fn_wp04_readiness_source_fingerprint(p_period_start date)
 RETURNS TABLE(fingerprint jsonb, digest text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'costing', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_period date;
  v_val date;
  v_run bigint;
  v_epochs jsonb;
  v_defs text;
  v_schema text;
  v_fp jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_period_start IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Period is required'; END IF;
  v_period:=date_trunc('month',p_period_start::timestamp)::date;

  SELECT valuation_date INTO v_val
  FROM costing.cost_periods
  WHERE period_start=v_period;
  IF v_val IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Governed valuation date missing for %',v_period; END IF;

  SELECT id INTO v_run
  FROM costing.costing_refresh_run
  WHERE period_start=v_period
    AND valuation_date=v_val
    AND overall_status='SUCCESS'
  ORDER BY finished_at DESC NULLS LAST,id DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(source_relation,epoch ORDER BY source_relation)
  INTO v_epochs
  FROM costing.readiness_portfolio_source_epoch;

  SELECT string_agg(sig||'='||md5(pg_get_functiondef(to_regprocedure(sig))),'|' ORDER BY sig)
  INTO v_defs
  FROM unnest(ARRAY[
    'costing.fn_product_sku_readiness_live_core(bigint,date,date,bigint,jsonb,jsonb)',
    'costing.fn_wp04_c_live_core(bigint,date,date,bigint,jsonb,jsonb,jsonb)',
    'costing.fn_wp04_c_run_cohort(bigint[],date,date,bigint)',
    'costing.fn_wp04_c_run_assemble(bigint,date,date,bigint,costing.sku_direct_labour_allocation_snapshot,costing.sku_production_overhead_allocation_snapshot,costing.sku_qc_allocation_snapshot,costing.sku_materials_stores_allocation_snapshot,costing.sku_admin_finance_overhead_allocation_snapshot,costing.sku_marketing_expense_allocation_snapshot)',
    'costing.fn_wp04_c_enrich(jsonb,bigint,date,date,bigint,jsonb,jsonb)',
    'costing.fn_product_sku_readiness_shared_issues(date)',
    'costing.fn_product_process_route_readiness(date)',
    'costing.fn_resolve_sku_mrp_as_of(bigint,date)',
    'costing.fn_resolve_sku_selling_price_policy_as_of(bigint,date)',
    'costing.fn_resolve_sku_commercial_sales_basis_point(bigint,date,date)',
    'costing.fn_resolve_sku_sales_assumption_as_of(date,bigint,date)',
    'costing.fn_resolve_sales_allocation_default_policy_as_of(text,date)',
    'public.plm_sku_bom_revision_as_of(bigint,date)'
  ]::text[]) x(sig);

  v_defs:=v_defs
    ||'|view:costing.v_cost_driver_policy_registry='
    ||md5(pg_get_viewdef('costing.v_cost_driver_policy_registry'::regclass,true))
    ||'|view:costing.v_sku_commercial_sales_basis='
    ||md5(pg_get_viewdef('costing.v_sku_commercial_sales_basis'::regclass,true))
    ||'|view:costing.v_regional_marketing_evidence_review_queue='
    ||md5(pg_get_viewdef('costing.v_regional_marketing_evidence_review_queue'::regclass,true));

  SELECT string_agg(
    e.source_relation||':'||
    coalesce((
      SELECT string_agg(
        a.attname||'/'||a.atttypid::regtype::text||'/'||a.attnotnull::text,
        ',' ORDER BY a.attnum
      )
      FROM pg_attribute a
      WHERE a.attrelid=to_regclass(e.source_relation)
        AND a.attnum>0
        AND NOT a.attisdropped
    ),''),
    '|' ORDER BY e.source_relation
  )
  INTO v_schema
  FROM costing.readiness_portfolio_source_epoch e;

  v_fp:=jsonb_build_object(
    'contract_version','WP04_G7_TRACK_A_V2',
    'period_start',v_period,
    'valuation_date',v_val,
    'evidence_refresh_run_id',v_run,
    'source_epochs',v_epochs,
    'canonical_definition_digest',md5(v_defs),
    'source_schema_digest',md5(v_schema)
  );

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_fp,md5(v_fp::text);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_product_inactivation_requires_no_active_skus()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
    v_active_sku_count bigint;
begin
    if new.status is distinct from 'Inactive'
       or old.status is not distinct from 'Inactive'
    then
        return new;
    end if;

    select count(*)::bigint
    into v_active_sku_count
    from public.product_skus ps
    where ps.product_id = new.id
      and ps.is_active = true;

    if v_active_sku_count > 0 then
        raise exception
            'Cannot mark product % inactive while % active SKU(s) remain. Deactivate the SKUs first.',
            new.id,
            v_active_sku_count;
    end if;

    return new;
end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'costing', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Not authenticated'; end if;
  if not public.app_has_permission('module:manage-products', 'view') then
    raise exception 'Permission denied for module:manage-products';
  end if;
  return costing.fn_sku_activation_missing_items(p_sku_id);
